backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko canister with an empty actor.
feature_evidence.json: Lists implemented features, related files, and confidence metadata for the Techify landing page.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing frontend files and their roles in the Techify landing page.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment instructions for building and deploying the Techify landing page to the Internet Computer.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base setup with OKLCH design tokens and dark mode variables for branding.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document that loads the React app at the root element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Renders the Techify landing page as the main app view.
frontend/src/constants/techify.ts: Central constants for phone numbers, UPI ID, WhatsApp message, and pricing.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that loads an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and handles query invalidation on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder module for query-related utilities; unused for this static site.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base plus Inter font, OKLCH colors, gradient utilities, and accessibility focus styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, CSS, and renders the React root.
frontend/src/pages/TechifyLandingPage.ts: Main landing page implementing all sections, CTAs, UPI and WhatsApp links, and responsive UI.
frontend/src/utils/upi.ts: Provides helpers to generate UPI payment and WhatsApp support links using constants for IDs and messages.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, existing features, issues, and architectural notes for the Techify landing page.
